partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: SIGNOR-corroborated GOF inhibition
results.hypothesis: Direct GOF correction is more credible when the directional drug effect is independently represented by SIGNOR.
results.body: R160 requiring SIGNOR provenance on the decreased target effect
results.mechanism_rationale: The explicit GOF disease direction is paired with a curated SIGNOR drug-effect assertion rather than relying solely on targeted text mining.
results.trapi_notes: The target and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; effect provenance, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Dual-effect and multisource-binding GOF inhibition
results.hypothesis: GOF correction is more credible when direction is supported by two sources and binding by at least four independent sources.
results.body: R160 with at least two directional-effect sources and four direct-binding sources
results.mechanism_rationale: Independent effect and binding provenance reduce dependence on a single extraction channel while retaining explicit disease direction.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; cross-edge source cardinality, variant form, and ontology constraints require Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[seed_effect:AFFECTS]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND seed_effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND seed_effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND seed_effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
CALL (subject, gene) {
  MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
  WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
    AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
    AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  UNWIND coalesce(effect.primary_knowledge_sources, []) AS source
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT source) AS effect_sources
}
CALL (subject, gene) {
  MATCH (subject)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene)
  UNWIND coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, []) AS source
  RETURN collect(DISTINCT source) AS binding_sources
}
WITH subject, object, effect_sources, binding_sources
WHERE size(effect_sources) >= 2
  AND size(binding_sources) >= 4
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: DrugCentral-bound LOF activation
results.hypothesis: Direct LOF restoration is more credible when the activating drug-gene binding is represented by DrugCentral.
results.body: R161 requiring DrugCentral provenance on direct binding
results.mechanism_rationale: The source constraint isolates a compact pharmacological channel that contains both known exon-skipping treatments.
results.trapi_notes: The target and disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; binding provenance, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[binding:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND 'infores:drugcentral' IN coalesce(binding.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
